usage: 飼料 (zi6 liu2) is a noun used to describe the food given to animals like pets, livestock, or farm animals.
You can use 飼料 as the object of a sentence, for example, 我買咗飼料 (I bought animal feed).
It can appear with measure words when specifying quantity, such as 一包飼料 (one bag of animal feed).
飼料 can be combined with different types of animals to specify their feed, e.g., 狗飼料 (dog food).
It is commonly used in farming or pet-keeping contexts to talk about the diet or nutrition of animals.
